parsed.name: 通用控制台通信接口
parsed.description: 这是一个通用的控制台式通信接口，用于在实验室中通过文本命令或流式数据通道与仪器进行交互。它适合管理读写通信会话，例如启动、停止、关闭连接，以及处理输入输出数据流。
parsed.description_en: This is a generic console-style communication interface used in laboratories to interact with instruments through text commands or streaming data channels. It is suited for managing read/write communication sessions, including starting, stopping, closing connections, and handling input/output data streams.

actions.description_en: Wait for the communication task to finish.
Read the incoming communication data stream.
Write to the outgoing communication data stream.
